note: Sealed auth-setup provisioning config (SGK-2026-0433). Product-specific paths are permitted HERE because tests/fixtures is exempt from the preflight token scan, but never under src/. This file is the ONLY source of truth for the AuthSetupGuard allowlist: exactly register A / register B / login A / login B. Nothing else may be sent. The account secret in the register/login body is the account password; the SECRET consumed by the engine is the session token extracted from the login response (see token_extraction), NOT the password.
